title: Draw Freezes on FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit: Reasons and Release
content:
Draws on a line under FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit are frozen automatically when the line reaches the tier's freeze days past due, when a payment on the line is returned, or while a fraud review is open; a borrower may also ask for a freeze on their own line.

A line frozen for a returned payment is unfrozen only when the current date is later than the return date plus the returned-payment freeze days and the amount past due is 0.00. The freeze period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the return date. The return date is the date of the returned-payment entry on the line, and the amount past due is the one Larkspur's record of the line shows.

A line frozen for being past due is unfrozen once the amount past due is 0.00; a borrower-requested freeze is lifted at the borrower's request; a fraud-review freeze is lifted only by the fraud team. When several freeze reasons apply, the line stays frozen until every one is cleared, and the recorded freeze reason shows the most recent one. Interest, payments and fees continue normally while frozen.

## Reason and release

| Freeze reason | Starts | Released when |
|---|---|---|
| Past due | the line reaches the tier's freeze days past due | the amount past due is 0.00 |
| Returned payment | a payment on the line is returned | the current date is later than the return date plus the tier's returned-payment freeze days, and the amount past due is 0.00 |
| Fraud review | a fraud review is open | the fraud team lifts it |
| Borrower request | the borrower asks | the borrower asks for it to be lifted |

## Returned-payment freeze boundary (abstract cases, 10-day freeze)

| Current date | Amount past due | Line unfrozen for this reason |
|---|---|---|
| return date plus 10 days | 0.00 | No — not yet later than the end of the freeze period |
| return date plus 11 days | 0.00 | Yes |
| return date plus 11 days | above 0.00 | No |

Repaying the returned amount early does not shorten the freeze period. A line under both a returned-payment freeze and a fraud-review freeze stays frozen after the first is cleared until the fraud team lifts the second.
